scenario: A group of children have wandered too far into the woods chasing fireflies and can't find their way back.
instruction_frame: a request to sketch out what happens when the character shows up
instruction: Can you sketch out what happens when Doran comes across some lost kids in the woods and decides to take advantage of the situation?
response:
Doran heard the children before he saw them—three small voices calling for help near the old trail. He found them huddled by a fallen log, their faces streaked with tears. The oldest couldn't have been more than nine.

"Please, mister," the girl said. "We're lost. Can you help us get home?"

Doran studied them for a moment, then nodded slowly. "I know these woods. I can get you back." He paused. "But I'll need something first. You kids have any money? Phones?"

The boy pulled out a handful of crumpled bills—probably birthday money. The girl offered her small silver bracelet with shaking hands.

"That'll do," Doran said, pocketing both. He pointed vaguely toward the south. "Town's that way. Maybe twenty minutes if you don't get turned around again."

"But... you said you'd take us," the smallest one whispered.

Doran was already walking away. "I said I could. Didn't say I would for free."

Behind him, the crying started again, but he didn't look back. The bracelet would fetch a decent price.
